authority: User requests next stage under Stage116; authorized bounded cache method experiment A, no production B.
question: Honest residuals and risk-aware direction discovery, matched 2x2 on original110 readout.

folds.algorithm: sorted component sources shuffled; round robin3; hold source fold and purge every matching incoming from fit; nested folds1/2 within purged outer0-fit
folds.support: each side >=30 low50-100 and >=100 low100-200, each component >=100 incoming and >=1 source
folds.weights: each subset sum1 per incoming; original final weights unchanged

baseline.configuration: Stage87 original62,3 seeds,400 rounds, original params; training-side mean log residual offset per ensemble
baseline.development: outer0-fit in-sample and nested inner1/2 OOF; dev held source outer0
baseline.final: saved full-train direct_raw with train-only offset vs actual three-fold OOF with fold-training-only offsets
baseline.deployment: frozen original Stage87 direct_cal; no extra head offset; explicitly measure base distribution change

direction.params: original eta.04 lambda10 subsample.8 hist nthread1
direction.stratified: smoothmax of two MSE/traditional ratios T.1 +10*sum positive(protection normalized risk-limit)^2, including6 MSE and16 squared hinges; recompute group gradients at each round
direction.curvature: positive diagonal surrogate; drop nonlocal multiplier derivatives; gradient and Hessian rescaled together to total incoming weight each round

head.method: Stage115 RiskHead: min low-risk epigraph, all1.01 others1.03 and all8 two hinges; secondary min correction squared
head.solver: 2 SLSQP max250 ftol1e-10 per candidate, feasible normalized<=1e-7; approximate KKT, no certified global bound

selection.scope: only held-source/incoming-purged outer0 inside original train
selection.rule: lexicographic maximum positive violation of six MSE ratios and24 actual tail differences+2pp; then max two low-E RMSE/traditional; then fewer trees

mu_only.configuration: original direct baseline parameters seeds rounds; input only original first14 track features plus q/p0,q/p1,bend_x,bend_y; same original train/weights
mu_only.calibration: one original cal mean log offset after model freeze, same as original direct; diagnostic attribution only

evaluation.primary: cal_post OOF_stratified/direct and OOF_stratified/OOF_ordinary max of two low-E ratios, upper95<1 both needed for supported improvement; all arms and factorial contrasts reported
evaluation.bootstrap: original500 incoming component draws seeds389/390; conditional developed evaluation, not blind
evaluation.gates: unchanged1.05/1.01/1.03 and all8 three actual tails upper95<=+2pp;1.05 noninferiority only
evaluation.calibration: median/mean relative bias,R68,tail amplitude, predictedE decile mean trueE/response; no posthoc offset for arms

resources.reason: small hist trees and <=64leaf convex heads; process parallel CPU, no large dense GPU workload

stop: exactly four arms plus fixed mu-only diagnostic, no test-driven variants; unsupported OOF reports exact limitation; no new ROOT, production or sample cut; all original roles,K and missing retained
